description.text: Program Overview Public administrators who want to pursue managerial or leadership careers in either the public sector or in government positions should consider a degree in public administration. Earning a degree in public administration will help you develop the skills and gain the insights needed to plan and help formulate policy, and to manage, organize, and implement operations. The curriculum for public administration program is designed to help student develop competencies in personnel management, policy analysis, budgeting, organizational behavior, business management, and research methods. Students also explore the legal, social, economical, and political contexts of public administration. ProgramObjectives This program aims to turn out public administration specialists who have armed with a good command of the basic theory of government and organization and a sound knowledge of government operation, management and modern office routines. They should be capable of working efficiently in English and Chinese in administrative organs of government and non-government departments, social organizations and modern enterprises. MainCourses Public Administration, Public Finance, Civil Service System, Government and Politics in China, Public Relations, Administrative Law, Public Policy Analysis, Governmental Economics, History of Western Public Administration Theory, Public Utilities Management and other Characteristic Courses Duration Four Years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted BichelorDegree of Public Administrationby China University of Mining And Technology Future Career Graduates of Master of Public Administration mainly engaged in public service work in the public organization or public sector, and few of them work in administrative department of the private sectors. The four main employment organizations for MPA are government organizations, non-profit public organizations, consulting corporations, personnel and administrative department of companies.

duration.text: The Public Administration at China University of Mining And Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1916 USD/per year ￥ 13800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Additional materials Additional materials may be required

requirements.text: Applicants should have a good school record and be in good health，the applicants for undergraduate degree should be below 30 years old.
